OpenAI today launched a major update to its ChatGPT desktop app, introducing GPT Voice Mode, allowing users to handle work through conversation to complete tasks. This new feature is powered by GPT-Live, which is the upgraded voice mode that OpenAI previously brought to mobile earlier this month.

You can now get work done on Mac by talking to ChatGPT

Here are more details from today's app update release notes:

ChatGPT Voice, powered by GPT-Live, lets you handle work and coordinate tasks by talking in Chat, Work, and Codex in the ChatGPT desktop app. Turn on Voice Mode to start a new chat or task, then ask ChatGPT to launch, check on, or adjust work happening in other threads.

ChatGPT Voice works on both macOS and Windows, with Mac users getting the added benefit of Appshots. When used with ChatGPT Voice, Appshots lets ChatGPT reference the active window for better context.

ChatGPT Voice also works alongside OpenAI's powerful Computer Use feature, local files, and ChatGPT plugins.

The release notes note that Voice is available to desktop users on OpenAI's Plus, Pro, Business, Edu, and Enterprise plans. The new Voice Mode also works for remote use of ChatGPT on iOS.

Additionally, this week's ChatGPT desktop app update improves how project folders work.

Local projects in the ChatGPT desktop app can now contain multiple related folders. Select "Edit Project" from the Project menu to add folders and designate a primary one. New chats, Git operations, and automatic searches of AGENTS.md, skills, and config.toml will use the primary folder. Secondary folders can still be used for file search, read, and edit.

You can learn more about ChatGPT Voice here, and learn more about multi-folder local projects here.

9to5Mac's Take

Many still have strong feelings about the Codex app essentially becoming the new ChatGPT desktop app with ChatGPT Work added in. While the recent app updates have done the native Mac app no favors when it comes to the experience (or size), it's good to see OpenAI add modern features to the new Mac app.

Voice Mode was previously removed from the old Mac app, and the new GPT-Live feature offered on ChatGPT for iPhone and iPad was never added either. As of today, Mac finally has a native Voice Mode again, and one that's more capable than ever.
